name: 4012-longdecode-dsv2lite-tp8
model: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V2-Lite. Ungated on the Hub, ~31 GB of bf16 safetensors, and `DeepseekV2ForCausalLM` is in the pinned engine's registry.
parallelism: tp8. Tensor parallel only -- no pipeline, expert or data parallelism, no router, no external cache tier.
architecture: DeepseekV2ForCausalLM, 15.7B total / 2.4B active, bf16, 27 layers; MLA (kv_lora_rank 512 + qk_rope_head_dim 64) and 64 routed + 2 shared experts, top-6. The rest is in the checkpoint's own config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=64, warmup the first 15%, bounded at 768 requests with an 1800 s safety cap. The closed loop is part of the declaration: the server is meant to be saturated.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no shared prefix: 2048 prompt tokens and 1024 output tokens, fixed, seed 42. Sent to `/v1/completions` rather than the chat route, so no chat template shifts the prompt length; `ignore_eos` is forwarded there at this commit and `stream_interval` is already 1.
purpose: A long-form report writer on a mixture-of-experts model, 64 concurrent streams of 2048-token prompts across eight GPUs.
launch:
# sglang at commit 71ab0dabe0de235148258250ddee0f4dba4fb896 (`git describe --tags` =
# v0.4.3.post2-156-g71ab0dabe0d). Flat `key: value` only: a nested block is DROPPED by the flat
# parser, and the engine then runs without the option this file declares.

model-path: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V2-Lite
trust-remote-code: true

tp-size: 8
enable-flashinfer-mla: true

# 64 is in this engine's CUDA-graph capture list ([1, 2, 4] + [8, 16, ..., 160]), so every decode
# step replays a captured graph; above cuda_graph_max_bs the running batch leaves that path.
max-running-requests: 64

context-length: 8192
mem-fraction-static: 0.81
random-seed: 42
